pages.title: Hinged Door
pages.lead: Hinged door for negative temperatures down to −20 °C, with a CSI handle certified to EN 179:2008 and a heating cable on the blade. 92 mm polyurethane-insulated blade, available in one-blade or two-blade versions.
bullets: Shops: delicatessens, fish shops, ice cream parlours
Fish processing plants and the ice cream industry
pages.footnote: Suitable for cold rooms used for the processing and preservation of foods at negative temperature.

pages.html:
Hinged Door · Specification

Specification

ComponentSpecification
Steel thickness0.5 mm
HeaterDouble heater
Insulation typePolyurethane foam
Closed cell structure95%
Tensile strength3.0 kg/m²
Compressive strength1.62 kg/m²
Density42 kg/m³
ResistanceResistant to fire and rust; waterproof
ColourPolyester, RAL 9003, 25 micron

Standard dimensions

One-blade version

  • Up to 1200 × 2500 mm: blade with the CSI handle only.
  • From 1200 × 2500 mm up to 1500 × 2500 mm: blade with CSI handle plus closing latch (additional spring closing system).

Two-blade version

  • A mobile blade (the right one, unless otherwise specified) and a semi-fixed blade with 2 internal hatches, 1 above and 1 below.
  • Total width can be up to double that of the one-blade version.
  • The two blades can have different widths. The fixed blade is usually requested narrower.
